title: Free minix-like kernel sources for 386-AT
lineage: Third-party reproduction of Torvalds message states version 0.02 sources available by FTP and identifies supported GNU programs; original archive not inspected here. A later participant recollection in the collection says 0.01 had circulated earlier without public announcement.
